## Description

Implement S2.5-01c: add Members removal through the existing coordinator, checked browser forms, safe self-removal navigation, and trusted customer Audit metadata. Stacked on [#253](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/253).

Implementation and verification are in progress. This draft does not authorize a production rollout.

## Review

Tier and architecture comparison will be computed from the complete candidate against #253. Merge is blocked by incomplete implementation and checks, the parent PR, and any review required by repository policy.
